body: There's also a React InstantSearch Hooks version that was made for a [live coding example](https://algolia-storefront-demo-nextjs.netlify.app/search), relying on `useRefinementList()`. You can check out the code here as a starting point for your own implementation: https://github.com/algolia-samples/storefront-demo-nextjs/blob/main/components/ColorRefinementList.tsx.
